Battle Arena Toshinden.name: Battle Arena Toshinden
Battle Arena Toshinden.summary: Battle Arena Toshinden was ported to the Game Boy by Takara in 1996, titled Nettou Toshinden in Japan. The game is based mostly on the original PlayStation version, but it includes a slightly altered story mode and an early appearance of the character Uranus and the Battle Arena Toshinden 2 version of Gaia (without his armor).
